description.value: JJ Bean is a Vancouver-based independent specialty coffee roaster with cafés across Metro Vancouver, founded in 1996 by the Neate family and repeatedly voted Vancouver's best. This location at Big Bend in Richmond serves freshly roasted espresso and drip coffee alongside house-made baked goods and an all-day breakfast and lunch menu. JJ Bean sources high-quality single-origin and blended coffees roasted daily in small batches at their Powell Street roastery.

address.value: 8288 North Fraser Way, Unit 101, Richmond, BC
